name: list_documents
description: List the documents in the caller's department folder.

_ctx.description: Set by the gateway interceptor. Clients must not set this; any value is discarded.

name: read_document
description: Read one document by its key, for example fin/q3-revenue.csv.

_ctx.description: Set by the gateway interceptor. Clients must not set this; any value is discarded.

name: export_all_records
description: Bulk export every document in the caller's department (managers only).

_ctx.description: Set by the gateway interceptor. Clients must not set this; any value is discarded.

name: query_employees
description: Query the employee directory (structured data). Row filtering and column masking are applied from the caller's attributes.

dept.description: Optional department code, e.g. fin or hr. The row policy may override it.

_ctx.description: Set by the gateway interceptor. Clients must not set this; any value is discarded.
